note: The selected 13 universities: five primary robotics degrees and eight ECE/CE routes. Purdue’s engineering-technology alternative is a separate credential. New Rose-Hulman and Dearborn entries use corrected August 2026 evidence with current checks pending; WVU is not selected.

robotics_engineering.label: Primary robotics engineering degree
robotics_engineering.blurb: CMU, Michigan Ann Arbor, WPI, RPI and Michigan-Dearborn offer primary robotics degrees. Entry and declaration rules differ; Dearborn’s current admission route needs confirmation.

ece_robotics_route.label: ECE / CE robotics route
ece_robotics_route.blurb: A primary engineering degree with controls, embedded systems, autonomy and optional AI courses; minors and registration permissions differ.

robotics_engineering_technology.label: Robotics engineering technology alternative
robotics_engineering_technology.blurb: Purdue Polytechnic is a separate applied technology route. Compare it with Computer Engineering through FYE/T2M.

callouts.title: Choose the correct application route
callouts.body: CMU BSR requires SCS admission; Michigan Robotics requires Engineering then declaration; WPI admits to the university; RPI’s new ROBT is a primary major. These are not interchangeable admission processes.

callouts.title: AI supports the robotics foundation
callouts.body: Prioritize controls, embedded hardware, sensing, kinematics, planning and projects. Choose machine learning and vision electives that your actual major can access.

programs.home_unit: Robotics Institute, School of Computer Science
programs.route: Apply to the School of Computer Science, then declare BSR after first year. Non-SCS transfer is competitive: 3.0 overall QPA, 3.6 across six specified courses, essay and available space. The Robotics Additional Major is a separate credential.
programs.gate: SCS admission is the first-year route. Admission to another college does not secure a BSR transfer; ECE plus an Additional Major has different GPA, prerequisite and seat constraints.
programs.notes: A primary Robotics BS with required robot building, feedback control, kinematics, vision, and a two-course systems/capstone sequence. Three robotics electives and an SCS elective support planning and learning alongside real hardware.

programs.degree_name: BSE Electrical and Computer Engineering (Pratt) + Robotics & Automation certificate
programs.home_unit: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Pratt School of Engineering
programs.route: Apply to Pratt School of Engineering; Duke says neither school/program is easier to enter. Pratt degree page says declare major during summer after first year. No GPA/cap gate is stated on the retrieved degree page; absence of a published gate is not a guarantee.
programs.gate: Apply to Pratt School of Engineering; Duke says neither school/program is easier to enter. Pratt degree page says declare major during summer after first year. No GPA/cap gate is stated on the retrieved degree page; absence of a published gate is not a guarantee. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Pratt ECE provides required circuits, digital/computer systems and signals foundations; the Robotics & Automation certificate adds robotics and build work with controls, ML and perception electives. ECE naturally supplies the stored prerequisite for ECE 383L. CS in Trinity supplies stronger software/AI emphasis but needs extra engineering prerequisites for the same robotics core.

programs.degree_name: BS Computer Engineering — Robotics & Autonomous Systems + Distributed System & Software Design threads
programs.home_unit: School of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering
programs.route: Georgia Tech admits to the university and considers the intended major in review; choose Computer Engineering deliberately. Summer 2024+ freshman admits cannot later switch into BS CS.
programs.gate: Georgia Tech admits to the university and considers the intended major in review; choose Computer Engineering deliberately. Summer 2024+ freshman admits cannot later switch into BS CS. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: List Computer Engineering as the primary intended major, then choose Robotics & Autonomous Systems plus Distributed System & Software Design. Add ECE4252 machine learning and ECE4560 automation/robotics or ECE4580 vision through the thread/elective plan.

programs.degree_name: BS Electrical Engineering + Robotics and Autonomous Systems Minor (selective)
programs.home_unit: A. James Clark School of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
programs.route: Engineering LEP: direct Clark freshmen complete a45-credit gateway review. For Fall 2027+, transfers and current students changing into high-demand EE/CpE need B- calculusII/physics, C- chemistry,3.0 GPA and selective holistic review. Freshman section does not explicitly require direct major admits to re-compete.
programs.gate: Engineering LEP: direct Clark freshmen complete a45-credit gateway review. For Fall 2027+, transfers and current students changing into high-demand EE/CpE need B- calculusII/physics, C- chemistry,3.0 GPA and selective holistic review. Freshman section does not explicitly require direct major admits to re-compete. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply listing Electrical Engineering (Computer Engineering is a hardware/software alternative). Plan ENEE460/461 controls, ENEE452 embedded systems, ENEE436 ML and ENEE408I robotics capstone, and apply to the selective RAS minor when eligible.

programs.route: College of Engineering admission, then Robotics declaration after at least one Ann Arbor term, 2.0 GPA, good standing and C-or-better/placement credit in the required foundation categories. CS has a separate selection process.
programs.gate: Plan declaration prerequisites and a balanced selection among the six robotics core options. Robotics declaration is distinct from the separate CS selection process.
programs.notes: A 128-credit Robotics BSE with systems foundations, three of six core choices, technical electives, undergraduate robot-learning/perception courses and ROB 450 capstone.

programs.degree_name: BS Electrical Engineering — Controls and Robotics Concentration (EFY then CODA)
programs.home_unit: College of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
programs.route: Engineering First Year admission is not EE admission. CODA ranks qualified applicants for department-set seat capacity;2.0 continuation/CODA GPA guarantees only an available engineering program, not the intended EE or CS major.
programs.gate: Engineering First Year admission is not EE admission. CODA ranks qualified applicants for department-set seat capacity;2.0 continuation/CODA GPA guarantees only an available engineering program, not the intended EE or CS major. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply to Engineering First Year with Electrical Engineering intended; CODA into EE, then select Controls and Robotics. Build the elective plan around ECE441 robot motion planning, ECE455 industrial robotics, ECE411 ML or ECE425 deep learning, plus embedded/digital control electives.

programs.degree_name: BS Computer Engineering (or combined Computer Engineering and Computer Science) + Robotics minor
programs.home_unit: College of Engineering, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (the combined major is shared with Khoury College of Computer Sciences)
programs.route: DIRECT: major can be declared on admission. Engineering switches require 2.0 GPA plus C in required math and chemistry/physics; Robotics Minor requires 2.0 GPA and permits at most 50% major overlap.
programs.gate: DIRECT: major can be declared on admission. Engineering switches require 2.0 GPA plus C in required math and chemistry/physics; Robotics Minor requires 2.0 GPA and permits at most 50% major overlap. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply to Computer Engineering or combined Computer Engineering and Computer Science. The 2026-27 catalog requires embedded design, probability, engineering linear algebra and a two-term ECE capstone. Robotics Minor explicitly permits controls, navigation, vision and machine-learning electives; maximum 50% overlap with the major.

programs.degree_name: BS Electrical and Computer Engineering (direct admit), Control electives + Robotics and Autonomous Systems minor
programs.home_unit: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, College of Engineering
programs.route: DIRECT ECE: college memo documents direct first-year admission from Autumn 2023. Fall 2027 policy should be reconfirmed; CSE automatic enrollment language applies explicitly only to 2025-26.
programs.gate: DIRECT ECE: college memo documents direct first-year admission from Autumn 2023. Fall 2027 policy should be reconfirmed; CSE automatic enrollment language applies explicitly only to 2025-26. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply to Electrical and Computer Engineering at Columbus; ECE direct admission is documented from Autumn 2023. Select Control-domain electives and ECE 5307 Machine Learning. The Robotics and Autonomous Systems Minor requires 12 credits distinct from the major, with prerequisites intact. Reconfirm Fall 2027 entry policy.

programs.degree_name: BS Computer Engineering (West Lafayette First-Year Engineering, then Transition to Major), robotics/control and AI/ML electives
programs.home_unit: College of Engineering, Elmore Family School of Electrical and Computer Engineering
programs.route: FYE/T2M: West Lafayette engineering begins in First-Year Engineering. Choose Computer Engineering in Transition to Major; no direct first-year CE admission at West Lafayette. The T2M page’s 93-95% historical first-choice placement is an aggregate, not a CE guarantee.
programs.gate: FYE/T2M: West Lafayette engineering begins in First-Year Engineering. Choose Computer Engineering in Transition to Major; no direct first-year CE admission at West Lafayette. The T2M page’s 93-95% historical first-choice placement is an aggregate, not a CE guarantee. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply to First-Year Engineering at West Lafayette, then transition to Computer Engineering. Required/core ECE 36200 embedded microprocessors and ECE 36800 data structures provide hardware/software balance. Add controls, ECE robotics and AI electives subject to the cohort plan. The Computer Engineering AI/ML concentration exists; Automatic Control concentration is for Electrical Engineering.

programs.home_unit: School of Engineering; jointly run by the Dept. of Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering (ECSE) and the Dept. of Mechanical, Aerospace, and Nuclear Engineering (MANE)
programs.route: DIRECT primary ROBT major: official program invites incoming Class of 2030 to choose ROBT, with Fall 2026 first-year Introduction to Robotics. Current students may add or switch subject to program compatibility.
programs.gate: DIRECT primary ROBT major: official program invites incoming Class of 2030 to choose ROBT, with Fall 2026 first-year Introduction to Robotics. Current students may add or switch subject to program compatibility. Confirm elective prerequisites, permissions and degree applicability.
programs.notes: Apply to the primary BS in Robotics Engineering (ROBT). The official sample curriculum includes embedded control, robot programming, manipulation, mobile robotics and planning, control lecture/lab, mechatronics, an AI/ML elective and robotics capstone. Confirm the new program’s accreditation status and Fall 2027 course capacity.

programs.degree_name: Bachelor of Science in Robotics Engineering
programs.route: University admission followed by first-year major declaration, usually near the end of B Term. No separate competitive RBE declaration gate was found in the reviewed official guidance.
programs.gate: Seven-week course sequencing and elective prerequisites. RBE 4701 is Category II, offered at least every other year; future dates and seats are not assured.
programs.notes: The Unified Robotics sequence integrates mechanics, sensing, manipulation and navigation. Embedded systems, statics, controls and an RBE design MQP build a hardware foundation; undergraduate AI and vision electives add autonomy.

programs.home_unit: Purdue Polytechnic Institute, School of Engineering Technology (West Lafayette)
programs.route: Purdue admits first-year students to a chosen major, and Robotics Engineering Technology is listed as its own major on the admissions site. A student picks it as the primary major on the application.
programs.gate: Engineering technology route; separate from Engineering FYE/T2M
programs.notes: Applied Robotics Engineering Technology, not an EAC engineering degree. Compare mathematics/design requirements and graduate-program prerequisites; do not substitute a Northwest campus programme.

programs.degree_name: BS Computer Engineering + Multidisciplinary Minor in Robotics
programs.home_unit: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering; multidisciplinary robotics program
programs.route: BS Computer Engineering + Multidisciplinary Minor in Robotics; add degree-applicable AI and perception electives after checking prerequisites and the quarter-by-quarter plan.
programs.gate: Historical evidence describes institute-level admission with an intended major; no separate competitive CE gate was documented. Current rules remain to be confirmed.
programs.notes: CE supplies embedded systems and digital design, while the robotics minor adds controls, mobile robotics and multidisciplinary design. EE is the controls-focused alternative. Historical EAC accreditation is for the base CE/EE degrees, not the minor. Inherited degree total is 194 quarter credits; confirm overlap and AI elective applicability.
programs.verification_note: Reviewed inherited university-source evidence fetched August 16–18, 2026. No university document was freshly retrieved on October 14; current-cycle requirements, offerings and access remain pending confirmation.
